snippet.title: Red Spider 2: Exiled Remastered - Hong Kong Noir style Visual Novel First Trailer
snippet.description:
The relentless cycle of death for those who defy the destiny of the underworld.

This is the teaser trailer for "Red Spider 2: Exiled," a hardboiled visual novel remastered and set in the shadows of Hong Kong. Follow the path of the surviving girl as she becomes an assassin, and witness the intertwined fates of those around her...
An immersive cinematic novel told through over 1,000 visual cuts.
Experience the deeper, more complex story than its predecessor, now with beautifully remastered visuals.

■ Developer: studio wasp
■ Music: Yasunori Shiono, Yukio Nakajima 
■ Platforms: Windows / Mac / Android / iOS 
■ Languages: Voice: Japanese / Subtitles: Japanese / English / Traditional Chinese 
■ Official Website: https://www.rpgdl.org/rsl2r/en.html

#RedSpider2 #VisualNovel #HongKongNoir #IndieGame
